|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">またの名をローグ・リーダー。ホスの戦いでスノースピーダー隊を率いた。密閉型。スカイウォーカー中佐が操縦し、ダク・ロルタが尾砲の砲手を務めた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Rogue 1.

'''Card text:'''
May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Luke is piloting. May move as a react only to a Hoth location.

'''Lore:'''
Also known as Rogue Leader. Led the snowspeeder unit at the Battle of Hoth. Enclosed. Commander Skywalker piloted, with Dack Ralter as tail gunner.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore says またの名を (also known as) rather than “Designated”, and 中佐 rather than Commander.
